title: Configure protected release authority and environments
description:
The repository's account-side release authority is narrowly configured before any release workflow can consume it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One repository-only GitHub App with contents:write is the sole bypass actor for the candidate and final-tag rulesets; all other actors are denied create, update, and delete on those namespaces.
- [hard] REQ-02: Candidate-tag, final-release, candidate-escrow, npm-publish, final-GitHub, and secret-free release-resume environments have distinct documented reviewers and owners, with immutable releases enabled and repository workflow permissions read-only by default.
- [hard] REQ-03: A release-admin runbook and read-only acceptance evidence verify the App installation, rulesets, environment isolation, immutable-release setting, and absence of credential crossover without adding release-execution workflow YAML.

## Notes

Blast radius: GitHub repository settings and release-admin runbooks only; no fixed-ref primitive, execution workflow, tag, release, or candidate byte.
